name: Ecchi Shiyo!
source:
Main character is left alone for six months as his parents depart on a long-time trip. One day a self-proclaimed fiancé Otsuki appears before him claiming that she is asked to take care of protagonist by his father. Then childhood friend and classmate join in. All girls declare they love protagonist, and this way their strange communal life begins.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2020/03/vn-of-month-june-2006-h2o-footprints-in.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
主角的父母出门远行，把他独自留在家中半年。一天，一名自称是他未婚妻的大槻突然现身，声称受主角父亲所托前来照顾他。之后，主角的青梅竹马和女同学也加入进来。所有女孩都公开表示爱着主角，一段奇妙的同居生活就此开始。

[引自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2020/03/vn-of-month-june-2006-h2o-footprints-in.html]vndbreview[/url]]
